roadmaps.name: A. Counter first (recommended)
phases: Staffed Surrey counter, vans, pickups, trucks, cars
Trade accounts and monthly van hire
After-hours key boxes, then app self-service

roadmaps.name: B. Self-service van share
phases: Set-up plus telematics and remote ID checks
24/7 app pickup at one Surrey lot, vans and pickups
Hourly stations where no car share runs (Langley, White Rock)
gates: Damage and no-show costs within budget

roadmaps.name: C. Fleet-light
phases: Own fleet on Turo, winter idle days
Owner-supplied vehicles under Ember Rent's brand
gates: ICBC, PVRT and Surrey licence answers in writing
